title: A methodology for estimating indoor sources contributing to PM2.5
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2024, 26,2288-2296
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00538D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shiva Nourani, Ana María Villalobos, Héctor Jorquera
Exposure to indoor PM2.5 originating from indoor sources is relevant, and PM2.5 chemical speciation data is necessary to estimate this exposure. This work proposes a new approach to quantify such exposure.
